definitions.actor_encoder_shift_marker: lost and >=10/20 source states with feature cosine <.90; descriptive only
definitions.caveat: labels nonexclusive; threshold fixed before Q/encoder numeric inspection; serially correlated states and reused roads
definitions.critic_q1_reversal_marker: lost and >=10/20 source states with source Q1 preferring source AND r6 Q1 preferring r6
definitions.early_policy_drift_marker: lost and same-initial-observation native action Linf >=.10
definitions.finish_or_late_stage_marker: lost with observed max visited-tile progress >=.90; may still be pre-finish
definitions.insufficient_source_state_retention: not identifiable per TRAIN-DIAGNOSTIC cell: TRAIN road pool disjoint and replay has no images
definitions.other_or_indeterminate: lost with none of the four positive markers; absence of markers is not absence of mechanisms
definitions.source_also_failed_adaptation_not_establ: both_failed, not an observed regression of a source success

scope: source-success regression markers on reused TRAIN-DIAGNOSTIC; NOT causal attribution or fresh/generalization evidence
